description: Everything around the model that turns predictions into actions: loop, tools, context management, permissions, sandbox, hooks, verifiers and state.
The same model behaves very differently in different harnesses; agent leaderboards rank model and harness pairs.
Guides steer the agent before it acts (context files, examples); sensors observe afterwards so it can self-correct (tests, linters, review).
The harness built into the product you use, versus the context files, rules, hooks and tests your team configures on top.
A Markdown file in the repository loaded into every agent session: commands, conventions, an architecture map, pointers to docs.
An open, tool-neutral context file format read by many coding agents; the nearest file to the edited code applies.
Claude Code's context file, at project, user and organization levels; treated as guidance, not enforced configuration.
